theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Utilities (+0.92%) and Communication Svcs (+0.26%) led the market today, while Energy (-0.90%) and Materials (-0.75%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.04%, defensives +0.01%, and value/cyclicals -0.38% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.17%, Dow -0.26%, Nasdaq -0.09% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.35%. The VIX fell 0.19% to 16.04, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.26% to $4,216.50, crude oil was little changed at $89.25, and bitcoin gained 0.04% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
